description: This file defines a class 'Lcm' that calculates the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of multiple numbers, including helper methods for factorization and processing factors.

classes.name: Lcm
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to compute the Least Common Multiple of multiple numbers.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the lowest common multiple (LCM) of a series of numbers, handling multiple input formats and errors.

methods.name: factors
methods.description: Returns an array of the factors of a given value, used internally for prime factorization.

methods.name: processPoweredFactors
methods.description: Helper method that processes and combines factors' powers for LCM calculation.

methods.name: testNonNulls
methods.description: Checks if there are any non-null values among input arguments, throwing an exception if none are found.
